name: list_web_apps
description: Lists web apps for a given enterprise. Requires the enterprise resource name in the parent field (e.g., enterprises/{enterpriseId}).

parameters.description: Request to list web apps for a given enterprise.

pageSize.description: The requested page size. This is a hint and the actual page size in the response may be different.

pageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results returned by the server.

parent.description: The name of the enterprise in the form `enterprises/{enterpriseId}`.
